name: Prince Edward Island

standard.note: PEI refreshed its plate in late 2022 with a simple, high-visibility design as it moved to 6-digit numbers, and added a distinct plate for electric vehicles.

plates.title: Canada's Food Island
plates.fact: Every dollar of the extra fee goes to Island food banks.

plates.title: Wildlife Conservation - Red Fox
plates.fact: The red fox was the most popular conservation plate in 2015, with over 5,500 registered.

plates.title: Wildlife Conservation - Blue Jay
plates.fact: The blue jay is PEI's provincial bird.

plates.title: Wildlife Conservation - Lady's Slipper
plates.fact: The lady's slipper is PEI's provincial flower.

plates.title: Electric Vehicle
plates.fact: PEI's first plate just for electric vehicles arrived with the 2022 redesign.

plates.title: Volunteer Firefighter
plates.fact: Active volunteer firefighters register their vehicle free.

plates.title: Retired Volunteer Firefighter
plates.fact: For retired volunteers with at least 15 years of active service.

plates.title: Paramedic License Plate
plates.supports: Developed with the Paramedic Association of PEI
plates.fact: Available in English and French, it shows a red maple leaf and the Star of Life.
